source: Earthdawn 4E — talents. Mechanics + original-wording summaries (no verbatim rulebook prose). Consolidated single file (replaces the separate talents.descriptions.json).
notes: 460 talents catalogued. Mechanics (name/action/attribute) for all; strain/skillUse/tier/summary/effects fully authored for Chakka's 24 talents plus all 22 Thief/Warrior discipline talents — the rest are enriched incrementally.
Talent step = attribute step + rank (attribute-less talents like Durability/True Shot use rank only).

Karma: every talent test is Karma-eligible BY DEFAULT (core rule; the engine handles this, so eligible talents carry no flag). Set "karma": false only on a talent that 'notes otherwise'. Versatility-learned talents can never use Karma either, but that is per-character (a "viaVersatility": true flag on the character's talent entry), not a property of the talent itself.
Effects follow docs/EFFECT-TAXONOMY.md; action outcomes use condition:on-success (+ perSuccess where they scale).

Air Dance.name: Air Dance
Air Dance.summary: Float on a cushion of air, using the Air Dance step for the Initiative test; with three successes on a close-combat Initiative comparison, gain an additional close-combat attack. Once per round; requires the ability to move.

effects.summary: Air Dance step substitutes for Dexterity on Initiative; 3 successes grant an extra close-combat attack.

Anticipate Blow.name: Anticipate Blow
Anticipate Blow.versus: target's Mystic Defense (requires higher Initiative than the target)
Anticipate Blow.summary: Read a foe you out-initiative (vs Mystic Defense): each success adds +2 to your Physical Defense against that foe's attacks until end of round, and +2 per success to your first Attack test against them. Usable up to rank times per round.

effects.summary: +2 Physical Defense vs that foe's attacks until end of round (per success).

effects.scope: first Attack test vs the target
effects.summary: +2 per success to your first Attack test against the target.

Astral Sight.name: Astral Sight
Astral Sight.versus: Difficulty 6 (modified by conditions) / target's Mystic Defense
Astral Sight.summary: Perceive astral space — auras, imprints, and patterns; may examine the pattern of any target whose Mystic Defense is at or below the test result.

effects.summary: See astral patterns and magical auras.

Avoid Blow.name: Avoid Blow
Avoid Blow.summary: Reactively dodge or parry an incoming close- or ranged-combat attack; on a success the blow is avoided. Usable up to rank times per round (one attempt per attack); not usable while blindsided or surprised.

effects.summary: Negates the triggering attack.

Awareness.name: Awareness
Awareness.summary: Notice hidden or concealed things, used in place of a Perception test to spot a target: 1 success spots at short range, 3+ at medium range.

effects.summary: Spot the searched-for target (range by success level).

Conceal Object.name: Conceal Object
Conceal Object.summary: Hide one or more objects on the body, up to a combined Size equal to rank; the test result is the Difficulty to find them. Producing a concealed item grants the benefit of Surprise.

effects.summary: Object hidden; the result sets the Difficulty to find it.

Crushing Blow.name: Crushing Blow
Crushing Blow.summary: After a successful close-combat attack, substitute the Crushing Blow step for the Strength step on the Damage test.

effects.summary: Crushing Blow step replaces Strength step on the Damage test.

Durability.name: Durability
Durability.summary: Passive. Each rank permanently adds the Discipline's Durability value to the character's Death Rating and Unconsciousness Rating.

effects.summary: + (Discipline Durability x rank) to Death Rating and Unconsciousness Rating.

Earth Skin.name: Earth Skin
Earth Skin.summary: Spend a Recovery test and roll vs your Mystic Defense; each success adds +2 to Mystic Defense for rank hours. The test always scores at least one success.

effects.summary: +2 Mystic Defense per success for rank hours.

False Sight.name: False Sight
False Sight.summary: Intensify an illusion at the moment of creation (vs the effect's Dispel Difficulty, based on talent rank); each success adds +2 to the Difficulty of sensing or seeing through it for the illusion's duration.

effects.summary: +2 per success to the Difficulty of seeing through the illusion.

First Impression.name: First Impression
First Impression.summary: Make a strong first impression on someone newly met (vs Social Defense); on success improve their Attitude by one degree, more with extra successes.

effects.summary: Improve the target's Attitude by one degree (+ per extra successes).

Frighten.name: Frighten
Frighten.summary: Instill fear with a silent stare (vs Mystic Defense); each success imposes -2 to all the target's tests while frightened.

effects.summary: -2 to all the target's tests while frightened (per success).

Long Shot.name: Long Shot
Long Shot.summary: Imbue a ranged weapon with magical force, extending its effective range beyond normal limits.

effects.summary: Extend a ranged weapon's effective range.

Melee Weapon.name: Melee Weapon
Melee Weapon.summary: Close-combat attack with a hand-held weapon vs the target's Physical Defense; on a hit, make a Damage test.

effects.summary: Hit — follow with a close-combat Damage test.

Missile Weapon.name: Missile Weapon
Missile Weapon.summary: Ranged attack with a bow, crossbow, or similar projectile weapon against the target's Physical Defense; on a hit, make a Damage test.

effects.summary: Hit — follow with a ranged Damage test.

Mystic Aim.name: Mystic Aim
Mystic Aim.summary: Take careful, magically-marked aim at a visible target (vs Mystic Defense); each success grants +2 to ranged attacks against that target.

effects.scope: ranged attacks vs the marked target
effects.summary: +2 to ranged attacks against the marked target (per success).

Mystic Pursuit.name: Mystic Pursuit
Mystic Pursuit.summary: Sense the direction and relative location of a person or object by focusing on an item associated with it (a hair, a fragment, a Pattern Item).

effects.summary: Learn the target's relative location/direction.

Stealthy Stride.name: Stealthy Stride
Stealthy Stride.summary: Move quietly and unobtrusively; opposed by observers' Perception/Awareness to avoid being detected.

effects.summary: Move undetected past observers.

Temper Flesh.name: Temper Flesh
Temper Flesh.versus: your Toughness Step or Difficulty 6 (whichever is higher)
Temper Flesh.summary: Half-hour ritual (requires being rested and free of Damage and Wounds) rolling vs your Toughness Step or Difficulty 6: success adds rank to Health Ratings and Wound Threshold for one day; on a failure you take Damage equal to your Wound Threshold. Only one Temper Flesh effect at a time.

effects.summary: +rank to Health Ratings and Wound Threshold for one day on success; failure causes damage equal to Wound Threshold.

Throwing Weapon.name: Throwing Weapon
Throwing Weapon.summary: Ranged attack with a thrown weapon against the target's Physical Defense; on a hit, make a Damage test.

effects.summary: Hit — follow with a Damage test.

Tiger Spring.name: Tiger Spring
Tiger Spring.summary: Add the Tiger Spring rank as a bonus to the Initiative Step for the round; may be combined with other Initiative-boosting talents. Once per round.

effects.summary: +rank to the Initiative Step this round.

True Shot.name: True Shot
True Shot.summary: Spend extra Karma on a Missile or Throwing Weapons test (2 Strain), adding up to rank additional Karma to greatly boost accuracy.

effects.summary: Adds extra Karma (up to rank) to a ranged Attack test.

Waterfall Slam.name: Waterfall Slam
Waterfall Slam.summary: When you cause a Wound in close combat, the target must make a Knockdown test even if the damage would not normally require one; add rank to the Difficulty of any Knockdown tests your attacks cause.

effects.summary: Target must make a Knockdown test on a Wound; +rank to Knockdown Difficulties from your attacks.

Wood Skin.name: Wood Skin
Wood Skin.summary: Spend a Recovery test and roll; add the result to the Health Ratings for rank hours. When the effect expires, it carries away damage equal to that result.

effects.summary: Health Ratings raised by the result for rank hours; damage equal to the result departs when it expires.

Wound Balance.name: Wound Balance
Wound Balance.summary: Substitute the Wound Balance step for the Strength step on any Knockdown test while supporting your own weight; may be used while flying.

effects.summary: Use Wound Balance step instead of Strength step for Knockdown tests.

Picking Pockets.name: Picking Pockets
Picking Pockets.summary: Lift an item from another character's pocket or pouch; the test result is the Difficulty for Perception tests made to notice the theft.

effects.summary: Item removed; the result sets the Difficulty to notice the theft.

Danger Sense.name: Danger Sense
Danger Sense.summary: Supernatural awareness of hazards within rank ×10 yards: vs a trap or ambush's Initiative result, acting normally and avoiding the Surprise penalty when successful.

effects.summary: Act normally; avoid the Surprise penalty.

Disarm Trap.name: Disarm Trap
Disarm Trap.versus: Difficulty Number set by the gamemaster
Disarm Trap.summary: Render a trap inoperative vs a GM-set Difficulty; success disables the trigger (a Rule of One sets it off). Up to rank attempts per trap. Grants trap/ward detection with Awareness.

effects.summary: The trap's trigger is disabled.

Dispel Magic.name: Dispel Magic
Dispel Magic.summary: End an ongoing spell or talent effect within rank x2 yards; tested against a Difficulty based on the effect's power.

effects.summary: Cancel the targeted magical effect.

Engaging Banter.name: Engaging Banter
Engaging Banter.summary: Engage a target who can understand you in witty chat (vs Social Defense) for rank minutes; the target is distracted and harried, and each success imposes −2 on their Perception tests to notice anything but the adept.

effects.summary: Target distracted and harried for rank minutes.

Fast Hand.name: Fast Hand
Fast Hand.summary: Sleight-of-hand plus minor illusion to move one or two small items (no larger than 6 inches) between locations within reach; the test result is the Difficulty for observers to notice.

effects.summary: Items switched; the result sets the Difficulty to notice.

Haggle.name: Haggle
Haggle.summary: Buy or sell at a better price (vs Social Defense); each success moves the price 5% in the adept's favor. Up to rank tests per transaction; bargaining stops when either side fails.

effects.summary: Price shifts 5% in the adept's favor per success.

Second Attack.name: Second Attack
Second Attack.summary: Make an additional close-combat attack with the same weapon used in the first attack that round (vs Physical Defense); on a hit, roll Damage as normal.

effects.summary: Extra close-combat attack lands — follow with a Damage test.

Slough Blame.name: Slough Blame
Slough Blame.versus: higher of the accuser's or scapegoat's Social Defense
Slough Blame.summary: Concoct a plausible explanation and pass blame from one character to another (vs the higher of the accuser's or scapegoat's Social Defense, +1 per additional character) for rank minutes.

effects.summary: Blame passes to the scapegoat for rank minutes.

Spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
Spellcasting.summary: Cast a spell held in a matrix by testing against its Casting Difficulty; on success the spell takes effect.

effects.summary: Spell is cast; resolve its effect.

Spirit Talk.name: Spirit Talk
Spirit Talk.summary: Communicate with spirits and entities regardless of shared language (vs Mystic Defense) for a number of minutes equal to rank.

effects.summary: Converse with the spirit for rank minutes.

Steel Thought.name: Steel Thought
Steel Thought.summary: Reactively resist an ability targeting your Mystic Defense; on success you reinforce your will and the ability fails to affect you.

effects.summary: Negate an ability targeting your Mystic Defense.

Suppress Curse.name: Suppress Curse
Suppress Curse.summary: Temporarily nullify curses or negative magical effects on a target; tested against the highest effect Step/Dispel Difficulty (+1 per additional effect).

effects.summary: Suppress the target's negative magical effects.

Thread Weaving (Archer).name: Thread Weaving (Archer)
Thread Weaving (Archer).summary: Weave and maintain magical threads (to thread items, patterns, and Archer thread abilities such as Arrow Weaving); max active threads and thread rank equal to rank.

effects.summary: Enables weaving threads for thread items/abilities.

Thread Weaving (Nethermancer).name: Thread Weaving (Nethermancer)
Thread Weaving (Nethermancer).summary: Weave and maintain magical threads (to thread items, spell patterns, and Nethermancer abilities); max active threads and thread rank equal to rank.

effects.summary: Enables weaving threads for thread items/spell abilities.

Thread Weaving (Thief).name: Thread Weaving (Thief)
Thread Weaving (Thief).summary: Weave and maintain magical threads (to thread items, patterns, and Thief thread abilities such as Thief Weaving); max active threads and thread rank equal to rank.

effects.summary: Enables weaving threads for thread items/abilities.

Thread Weaving (Warrior).name: Thread Weaving (Warrior)
Thread Weaving (Warrior).summary: Weave and maintain magical threads (to thread items, patterns, and Warrior thread abilities such as War Weaving); max active threads and thread rank equal to rank.

effects.summary: Enables weaving threads for thread items/abilities.

Patterncraft.name: Patterncraft
Patterncraft.summary: Understand the workings of magic — read and write magical writing, and analyze magical patterns (e.g. translating grimoire pages).

effects.summary: Read/analyze magical patterns and writing.

Lock Picking.name: Lock Picking
Lock Picking.summary: Conjure telekinetic lock picks to open a lock: mundane locks vs a GM-set Difficulty, magical locks vs the lock's Mystic Defense. Up to rank attempts per lock; a Rule of One or total failure locks it until the rank rises.

effects.summary: The lock opens.

Karma Ritual.name: Karma Ritual
Karma Ritual.summary: A daily ritual (about an hour) that refills the character's Karma pool to its maximum.

effects.summary: Refills Karma to maximum.

Standard Matrix.name: Standard Matrix
Standard Matrix.summary: A basic spell matrix — an astral construct that safely holds one spell for casting without astral interference; rank governs the spell it can hold.

effects.summary: Holds one spell for safe casting.
